blocks.text: Yeh chapter 26 (Polymers) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are polymers? Explain their importance, the factors on which their properties depend, and how synthetic polymers are named. (4 marks)
(Polymers kya hain? In ki ahmiyat, un ki properties par asar daalne wale awamil, aur synthetic polymers ke naam rakhne ka tareeqa wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Polymers bohat bare molecules hain jo bohat se chhote molecules, monomers, ko polymerisation se jor kar bante hain.
2. Ahmiyat: organic polymers bari ahmiyat ke jadeed materials hain; behtar properties aur kam qeemat ki wajah se inhon ne zindagi aasaan, kaar-aamad aur kifayati banayi hai. Misalein: shopping bags (poly(ethene)), clothesline (poly(propene)), bulletproof vests (Kevlar®) aur aerospace.
3. Properties monomers ki qisam aur tadaad aur banane ke tareeqe par munhasir hain. Kuch bohat halke aur naram (poly(ethene), poly(propene)); kuch sakht aur garmi mein bohat mustahkam (Kevlar®).
4. Naam: monomer ke naam se pehle "poly" likhte hain: polythene = poly(ethene), polyvinylchloride = poly(chloroethene). Do ya ziyada monomers par systematic naam bohat lamba hota hai is liye aam naam istemal hota hai, jaise poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) ko polyethylene terephthalate (PETE) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Organic polymers are modern materials of great significance.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe addition polymerisation, giving its main features and the formation of poly(ethene) as an example. (4 marks)
(Addition polymerisation ko us ki bari khoobiyon aur poly(ethene) ki misal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Tareef: addition polymerisation mein monomers aik aik kar ke jur kar lambi chains banate hain; asal monomers ke tamaam atoms polymer ka hissa bante hain, kuch zaya nahi hota.
2. Shart: monomers mein carbon-carbon double (C=C) ya triple (C≡C) bond ho jo khul kar monomers ko jorta hai.
3. Paani jaisa koi chhota molecule side product ke taur par nahi banta.
4. Yeh aksar chain reaction se hota hai jo aik bohat reactive molecule, initiator, shuru karta hai jo free radicals banata hai.
5. Misal: bohat se ethene molecules double bonds tor kar siron se jur jate hain:
   n CH₂=CH₂ → —[CH₂—CH₂]ₙ— (poly(ethene))

book_ref.quote: This often happens through a "chain reaction" started by a very reactive molecule

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the two types of poly(ethene). How does the nature of their chains explain their properties? State the role of the Ziegler-Natta catalyst. (4 marks)
(Poly(ethene) ki do qismein bayan karein. In ki chains ki nauiyat in ki properties ki wajah kaise hai? Ziegler-Natta catalyst ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Poly(ethene) ki do qismein hain: low density poly(ethene) (LDPE) aur high density poly(ethene) (HDPE). HDPE ethene se Ziegler-Natta catalyst ke zariye kam pressure aur temperature par banti hai. Karl Ziegler ne 1953 mein daryaft kiya; is ne pehli baar ethene ki kam pressure par linear HDPE mein polymerisation mumkin ki; Giulio Natta ne is se stereoregular polymers jaise crystalline polypropylene banaye.

book_ref.quote: It finds its uses in plastic containers, thick shopping bags, toys, etc.

rows: Kam solid, ziyada lachakdar, halka aur naram
Plastic containers, mote shopping bags, khilone

blocks.prompt:
4 Write the equation for the formation of PVC. Describe the properties of rigid and plasticised PVC and give four uses of PVC. (4 marks)
(PVC banne ki equation likhein. Rigid aur plasticised PVC ki properties bayan karein aur PVC ke chaar istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Banna: poly(chloroethene) chloroethene se addition polymerisation se banta hai: n CH₂=CHCl → —[CH₂—CHCl]ₙ—.
2. Rigid PVC (bina plasticizers): sakht aur akra hua, aasani se nahi murta; chemically inert (ziyada tar acids, bases, oils se react nahi karta); bijli ka achha insulator; chlorine atoms ki wajah se jalne se bachta aur khud bujh jata hai; der tak chalta aur mausam ka asar bardasht karta hai.
3. Plasticised PVC: plasticizers chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces kam karte hain taake chains aazadi se harkat karen; PVC lachakdar aur naram, aasani se murne wala ban jata hai, chemical aur electrical properties achhi rehti hain magar kam sakht hota hai.
4. Istemal: paani, drainage aur sewage ke pipes (zang se bachao, paaidaari); khirkiyon ke frame, darwaze, farsh ki tiles; taaron aur cables ki insulation; tubing, blood bags, catheters; cling films, bottles, blister packs; raincoats, artificial leather, hawa bharne wali cheezen.

book_ref.quote: PVC is a versatile type of plastic.

blocks.prompt:
5 Define condensation polymerisation and describe its main features. (4 marks)
(Condensation polymerisation ki tareef karein aur is ki bari khoobiyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Tareef: condensation polymerisation mein monomers jurte hain magar har naye bond par monomers se aik chhota molecule nikalta hai.
2. Yeh molecule aam taur par paani hai; HCl, CH₃OH ya NH₃ bhi ho sakta hai. Chhote molecules hamesha side product ke taur par bante hain.
3. Monomers mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (jaise -OH, -COOH, -NH₂) hon jo mukhtalif siron par hon.
4. Reaction aam taur par qadam ba qadam hota hai (Figure 26.3).
5. Do groups aik molecule mein (lactic acid, amino acids) ya do mukhtalif molecules mein (diol + dicarboxylic acid, diamine + dicarboxylic acid) ho sakte hain. Bari qismein: polyesters (ester links) aur polyamides (amide links).

book_ref.quote: Small molecules are always produced as a side product.

blocks.prompt:
6 What are polyesters? Describe the preparation of Terylene (PET) with an equation and give the uses of polyesters. (4 marks)
(Polyesters kya hain? Terylene (PET) ki tayyari equation ke saath bayan karein aur polyesters ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Polyesters ki backbone mein ester links [—C(=O)—O—] hote hain.
2. Monomers: diol (do -OH groups) aur dicarboxylic acid (do -COOH groups). Diol ka -OH acid ke -COOH se react karta hai aur har link par aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai.
3. Ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se Terylene/PET:
   n HO–CH₂–CH₂–OH + n HOOC–C₆H₄–COOH → —[O–CH₂–CH₂–O–CO–C₆H₄–CO]ₙ— + 2n H₂O
4. Istemal: ziyada tensile strength ki wajah se fibres; cotton ki jagah (sasta, silwat nahi parti); plastic ke taur par mashroobat ki PETE bottles aur food packing; sakht plastics mein cross links, jaise glass fibre reinforced cross-linked polyester.

book_ref.quote: The -OH from the diol reacts with the -COOH from the acid.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Har repeat unit mein do ester links hain (diol ke dono siron par), aur har link aik H₂O nikalta hai, is liye n units par 2n H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe three methods of preparing polyamides, with a general equation for each. (4 marks)
(Polyamides tayyar karne ke teen tareeqe, har aik ki general equation ke saath, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Polyamides ki backbone mein amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] hote hain.
1. Diamine + dicarboxylic acid: diamine ka -NH₂ acid ke -COOH se react karta hai aur paani nikalta hai:
   n H₂N–R–NH₂ + n HOOC–R′–COOH → —[NH–R–NH–CO–R′–CO]ₙ— + 2n H₂O (misal: hexamethylenediamine aur adipic acid se nylon-6,6).
2. Diamine + dioyl chloride (do -COCl groups, dicarboxylic acids se ziyada reactive): -NH₂, -COCl se react karta hai aur HCl nikalta hai:
   n H₂N–R–NH₂ + n ClOC–R′–COCl → —[NH–R–NH–CO–R′–CO]ₙ— + 2n HCl
3. Amino acid (aik monomer jis mein -NH₂ aur -COOH dono hain): aik amino acid ka -NH₂ doosre ke -COOH se react kar ke paani nikaalta hai aur peptide bond (amide link ki qisam) banta hai:
   n H₂N–CHR–COOH → —[NH–CHR–CO]ₙ— + n H₂O. Proteins isi qisam ke natural polyamides hain.

book_ref.quote: Polyamides have amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] in their backbone. They can be prepared from many starting materials.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pehle do tareeqon mein har repeat unit mein do amide links hain is liye 2n chhote molecules nikalte hain; amino acid wale unit mein aik link hai is liye n H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the formation of an amide linkage from an acyl chloride and ammonia or an amine. Write equations with ammonia and with methanamine. (4 marks)
(Acyl chloride aur ammonia ya amine se amide linkage banne ki wazahat karein. Ammonia aur methanamine ke saath equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Acyl chlorides bohat reactive organic compounds hain. Yeh ammonia ya amine (jaise methanamine CH₃-NH₂, (CH₃)₂NH) se react kar ke amide linkage banate hain.
2. Har soorat mein hydrogen chloride (HCl) gas ka aik molecule nikalta hai, is liye yeh condensation hai.
3. Equations:
   R–COCl + NH₃ → R–CO–NH₂ + HCl
   R–COCl + CH₃–NH₂ → R–CO–NH–CH₃ + HCl
4. Acyl chlorides kaafi reactive hain is liye yeh reaction room temperature par aasani se hota hai. Monomers ke dono siron par -COCl aur -NH₂ (dioyl chloride + diamine) ho to yahi reaction polyamide banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Amide linkage is also formed between acyl chlorides, a very reactive organic compound and an amine, e.g. ammonia.

blocks.prompt:
9 What is nylon? Describe the preparation of nylon-6,6 with an equation and explain its name. (4 marks)
(Nylon kya hai? Nylon-6,6 ki tayyari equation ke saath bayan karein aur is ke naam ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Nylon aik synthetic polyamide hai jo condensation polymerisation se banta hai, aam taur par diamine (H₂N-R-NH₂) aur dicarboxylic acid (HOOC-R-COOH) se; aik chhota molecule, aam taur par paani, nikalta hai.
2. Nylon-6,6 sab se aam misal hai. Monomers: 1,6-diaminohexane, H₂N–(CH₂)₆–NH₂ (hexamethylenediamine), aur hexanedioic acid, HOOC–(CH₂)₄–COOH (adipic acid; is ke COOH carbons C1 aur C6 hain).
3. Equation:
   n H₂N–(CH₂)₆–NH₂ + n HOOC–(CH₂)₄–COOH → —[NH–(CH₂)₆–NH–CO–(CH₂)₄–CO]ₙ— + 2n H₂O
4. -NH₂ groups -COOH groups se react kar ke amide links banate hain. Naam: dono monomers mein chhe chhe carbon atoms hain (diamine mein 6, diacid mein 6), is liye 6,6.

book_ref.quote: Nylon 6,6 is the most common example of synthetic amides.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Nylon-6 ka naam is ke chhe carbon wale monomer se hai; isi tarah 6,6 mein pehla 6 diamine ke aur doosra 6 diacid ke carbon atoms batata hai.

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the formation of nylon-6. Why is it classified as a condensation polymer? Compare it with nylon-6,6. (4 marks)
(Nylon-6 ka banna bayan karein. Ise condensation polymer kyun shumaar kiya jata hai? Nylon-6,6 se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nylon-6 aik akele monomer caprolactam se banta hai jis ki structure cyclic hai; ring khulti hai aur units amide links se jurti hain: n caprolactam → —[NH–(CH₂)₅–CO]ₙ—. Monomer mein chhe carbon atoms hain is liye naam nylon-6 hai. Koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta is liye yeh aam condensation nahi; phir bhi amide linkage banne ke tareeqe ki wajah se condensation polymer shumaar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is named nylon-6 because it involves a monomer with six carbon atoms.

rows: Kam melting point, aasani se mold
Hamwaar satah, chot sehne ki ziyada salahiyat
Rollers, skateboard wheels, power tool handles

blocks.prompt:
11 State the properties of nylon and relate each to its industrial applications. (4 marks)
(Nylon ki properties likhein aur har aik ko is ke sanati istemal se joren.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Mazboot, tootta nahi, ragar aur ghisaawat bardasht karta hai: screws, nuts, bolts jaise machine purze jahan taqat aur ghisaawat se bachao chahiye.
2. Elasticity ki wajah se khinchne wala: kapre (stockings, activewear, swimwear), qaleen aur rassiyan; raincoats aur sportswear ka kapra.
3. Phisalne wali satah, kam ragar, aur ziyada melting point (garmi bardasht): gaariyon ke purze jaise gears, bearings, bushings, engine covers aur fuel lines.
4. Ziyada tensile strength aur paani ki ghisaawat se bachao: rassiyan, machhli ke jaal aur doriyan.
5. Oils, bohat se solvents aur alkalis ka asar nahi; roz-marra ki cheezen jaise zippers, toothbrushes, hairbrushes aur molded plastic purze.

book_ref.quote: Nylon is also used in making of machine parts such as screws, nuts, bolts

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the steps used to identify the type, the repeat unit and the monomers of a polymer from a section of its structure. (4 marks)
(Polymer ke structure ke hisse se us ki qisam, repeat unit aur monomers pehchanne ke qadam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Polymer ki qisam: backbone (main horizontal chain ke atoms) pehchanein. Sirf carbon (-C-C-C-C-): addition polymer, alkenes se bana. Carbon ke saath O ya N: condensation polymer.
2. Functional linkage: C=O seedha O ke saath = ester linkage (polyester, jaise PET); C=O seedha H wale N ke saath = amide ya peptide linkage (polyamide, jaise nylon-6,6, Kevlar).
3. Repeat unit: sab se chhota dohrane wala hissa dhoondein jahan se sequence dohrata hai; aik aise hisse ke gird brackets lagayein aur subscript n likhein.
4. Monomers: addition polymers mein repeat unit ke C-C single bond ko wapis C=C banayein (jaise —[CH₂—CHCl]ₙ— se CH₂=CHCl). Condensation polymers mein paani wapis jorein: ester ya amide bond torein, C=O wali taraf -OH aur O ya N wali taraf -H lagayein.

book_ref.quote: To identify a polymer from a skeletal or structural formula, you must look for the repeating linkage and the monomer units.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain how the structure of the monomer(s) can be used to predict the type of polymerisation, with examples. (4 marks)
(Wazeh karein ke monomer(s) ki structure se polymerisation ki qisam ka andaaza kaise lagaya jata hai, misalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Addition: jab monomer(s) mein C=C bonds hon to addition polymerisation hoti hai, jaise ethene, propene, phenyl ethene (styrene). Ziyada tar homopolymers bante hain; kabhi double bond wale do mukhtalif monomers copolymer banate hain, jaise ethene aur propenoic acid (H₂C=CH-COOH).
2. Condensation: jab bond ya bridging linkage banane ke liye do functional groups mojood hon to condensation polymerisation hoti hai; aam taur par chhota molecule nikalta hai. Do groups aik molecule (lactic acid) ya do mukhtalif molecules (nylon-6,6) mein ho sakte hain.
3. Groups ke jore aur un ke products table mein hain.

book_ref.quote: Mostly, a small molecule is removed from the two monomers during the formation of the polymer.

blocks.prompt:
14 What is meant by non-degradable polymers? Explain the challenges they create for the environment. (4 marks)
(Non-degradable polymers se kya muraad hai? Mahol ke liye in ke paida kiye masail wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Matlab: poly(ethene) jaise aam polymers, jo sab se ziyada istemal hone wala polymeric material hai, non-degradable hain: yeh saade ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot nahi sakte, is liye phenkne ke baad mahol ke liye museebat bante aur paani, mitti aur qudrati maskan mein shamil ho jate hain.
2. Baqi rehna: yeh bohat lambe arse tak mahol mein rehte aur landfills, samundaron aur qudrati manazir mein jama hote hain.
3. Landfills: na galne ki wajah se bohat jagah gherte hain; aabadi barhne se landfills ki jagah mushkil se milti hai.
4. Janwar, khaas kar samundari, plastic ko khana samajh lete hain (dam ghutna, andaroni zakhm, bhook) ya is mein ulajh jate hain.
5. Microplastics: bare tukre nihayat chhote tukron mein toot kar mitti, paani aur hawa ko aaloda karte aur food chain mein daakhil ho sakte hain. Is liye scientists biodegradable aur photodegradable polymers bana rahe hain.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, scientists are now developing degradable polymers to cope with this issue.

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe biodegradable and photodegradable polymers, giving how each breaks down and one limitation or use of each. (4 marks)
(Biodegradable aur photodegradable polymers bayan karein: har aik kaise toot-ta hai aur har aik ki aik khami ya istemal.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Biodegradable plastic kuch arsa dabane par microorganisms se qudrati taur par saade ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot jata hai. Starch jaise natural polymers wale plastics jaldi toot-te hain kyun ke mitti ke bacteria natural polymers par aasani se hamla karte hain; poly(lactic acid) (PLA) biodegradability barhata hai.
2. Istemal: jism mein hydrolysis se aahista toot-ne wale polyesters kuch medical implants aur ghul jane wale taankon mein istemal hote hain.
3. Photodegradable polymers mein aise functional groups hain jo dhoop se UV light ki shakal mein ziyada energy jazb karte hain; ziyada photoabsorption ke liye chains mein carbonyl groups (C=O) wale polymers banaye gaye hain. UV jazb hone se chain ke bonds aur chains ke darmiyan forces kamzor hoti hain, polymer ziyada biodegradable ho kar jaldi kam zehreele compounds mein toot-ta hai.
4. Photodegradable plastics ki khamiyan: der tak istemal nahi ho sakte, recycling achhi nahi, aur landfills mein dabane par roshni nahi milti.

book_ref.quote: This makes a polymer more biodegradable, thus accelerating its decomposition into less toxic compounds in the natural environment.

blocks.prompt:
16 Explain the use of polymers in artificial organs. State the requirements of such polymers and give the polymers used in four artificial organs. (4 marks)
(Artificial organs mein polymers ke istemal ki wazahat karein. Aise polymers ki zaroori khoobiyan aur chaar artificial organs mein istemal hone wale polymers likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Artificial organs insaan ke banaye aalaat hain jo kharab ya beemar aaza ki jagah lene ya un ke kaam mein madad ke liye hain. Jism mein istemal hone wale polymers biocompatible (jism ko nuqsan, allergy ya immune system ka radd na ho), mechanically moozoon, sterilize hone ke qabil, paaidaar aur tunable (taqat, lachak ya elasticity jism ke hisse ke mutabiq: naaliyon ke liye lachakdar, haddiyon ke liye mazboot) hone chahiye.

book_ref.quote: In biomedical science, polymers are very important for creating artificial organs.

rows: PTFE aur PET: hamwaar satah khoon jamne se rokti hai; band naaliyon ki jagah ya bypass
Specialized polyurethanes aur silicone: bohat lachakdar, paaidaar, khoon jamne se mehfooz
Collagen (natural) aur PLA (synthetic): nayi jild ke liye scaffold; kuch zakhm bharne par ghul jate hain
UHMWPE: hamwaar, kam ragar wali satah, harkat aasaan, ghisaawat ka muqabla
PMMA aur hydrogels: bilkul shaffaf aur biocompatible taake nazar wapis aaye
